findings.reasoningSummary: MEDIUM deliberation chosen following R45 open gap. Source 160/input 131 unchanged, core/learner/AST/Config/initial 0.5/typed source/order/guards/controller/history/Cost unchanged. Eight frozen bijections realized by inverse vocabulary to original R39/R40 runtime across 48 grounded 8-token 4-cohort sources, no monkeypatch/host semantic repair. 16 base cases achieve 8/8 distinct restricted maps (0 unchanged pairs, 336 changed pairs across 3 native arms), all 4 Hamming distances d in {0,1,2,3} per codebook, and 16/16 ordered Hamming pairs globally across upper pair gates (16/16 isometric, 13-14/16 non-isometric, plus 16/16 exhaustive in pair_transfer). Invalid maps and collapsed coverage reject; authored encoding not learner.

Each role Program/drive input/cfg/initial and all physical refs/full scalar/controller/Cost/source proof/slot/revision/sealed-payload consumer checked. 64 numeric role inputs partition into 4 exact Hamming equivalence classes d in {0,1,2,3} (max within-class spread 1.0408340855860843e-17); 40320 bijections/2580480 saved lookups/0 wrong at role stage. 16 pair settles exhaust all 4^2 Hamming pairs (16/16 correct, 645120 bijection-class checks with 0 wrong). 553 extremal envelope settles (or0..4 121/121, triple 64/64, projection_or2 16/16, projection_or4 256/256, consumer_pair 16/16, feasible2 16/16) verify [min,max] boundary intervals without claiming 64^n enumeration. Full pipeline 384 native/128 exact (2560 queries) and 336 paired conditions/336 invariant, finite adoption=true; native_joint/native_factor 640/640 truth and native_compact 544/640 truth, 640/640 closure, 96/640 extra_z abstention preserved; 100% of upper tick differences confined to role_ticks while pair/membership/triple/projection/query_input/query ticks are invariant (true). Max scalar error 2.220446049250313e-16; 22/22 mutations rejected.

38889 actual settles/1153068 ticks/72.68406292700092s within 240s stage/600s total, worker 1/retry 0. All three stages (preparation, work, audit) exited with returncode 0. Full source(48)/transfer(569, including 64 role)/upper(38272) call ledger, bounded aggregate cache 128MiB/raw 128MiB/AS 512MiB each/record 128KiB/unique 947<6000/LRU 18. Complete computed kernel+Config bytes confirm storage-only dedup; all calculations run. All phase CPU+parent seal+launcher measured=72.68448687600001; core/storage/source/transfer subset times not double added; no efficiency adoption gate or posthoc performance claim. All 974 non-empty files + manifest directly match original manifest size/SHA; 6 empty logs/ZIP not received, manifest outside own hash/upstream unknown/same-channel not attestation. Author CS review is not independent audit.
